title: RetroRequest
description: Line F O_RETRO_INVOKE signal (ENGINE_ISA.md §2.11): a mission worker's request that the campaign harness run a retrospective (m_retro) after this run. Written via the seat's always-on `fs.write` tool to a well-known filename in its own mission workspace — no new engine tool call surface, only a documented convention plus a harness-side detector (sciteam/retro_signal.py). Presence of a schema-valid file is the only thing that grants the request any effect; free-text narration elsewhere is never read for this purpose.

target_asset_hint.description: Optional: which incumbent asset the requester believes should be reviewed. Informational only — the retro mission still drafts and preflights its own proposals through the full amendment pipeline; this field carries no authority.
